templates.pattern:
Statements:
1. Some [A] are [B].
2. All [B] are [C].
3. All [C] are [D].
4. No [D] are [E].
Conclusion I: No [B] are [E].
Conclusion II: Some [A] are [D].
Conclusion III: No [C] are [E].
Conclusion IV: Some [A] are not [E].
Which all follow?
templates.explanation: All B→C→D + No D are E → No B are E (I valid), No C are E (III valid). Some A are B + All B→C→D → Some A are D (II valid), Some A are not E (IV valid). All four follow.
